items.question: What cities and communities do you cover?
items.answer: We place in Alberta’s largest cities, small towns, and fly-in northern regions.

items.question: Do I need specific rural or northern experience?
items.answer: It’s an asset, but not required. We provide travel and onboarding support.

items.question: Is housing included?
items.answer: Yes! Most contracts come with fully furnished accommodations.

items.question: Can I apply from another province?
items.answer: Yes! We help with licensing for CARNA, CLPNA, and interprovincial transfers.

items.question: Do you hire IENs?
items.answer: We welcome internationally educated applicants with the required Canadian credentials.

items.question: How much experience is required?
items.answer: A minimum of 2 years of Canadian clinical or care experience in your designated role.

blocks.html: We help you navigate the provincial licensing process and reimburse licensing fees under select terms and conditions—so you can focus on getting started stress-free.
Travel RNs in Alberta must hold an active nursing license and current BLS certification. Ensure your documents are valid and ready to upload.
All RNs and LPNs must be licensed through the College of Registered Nurses of Alberta (CRNA) or College of Licensed Practical Nurses of Alberta (CLPNA).
You may also need to submit a vulnerable sector check, immunization records, and proof of insurance. Our team will guide you through every step.
Have questions about Alberta nursing requirements? Our team can point you in the right direction and make sure you’re prepared for every step of the process.

Goodwill Staffing connects healthcare professionals with rewarding travel contracts across Alberta. From AHS roles to private employers, we support your growth with housing, travel, and licensing help.
